== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-rectenna-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Rectenna]] (Decipher; Decipher's [[Rectenna (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes: “any” becomes “your”; “If opponent just initiated” becomes “You may deploy cards as a 'react' to”; “system, you may 'react' by deploying cards (at normal use of the Force) to that system.” becomes “system or sector.”. These are the same words as [[Rectenna (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “Rectenna” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
